bias.en: Neutral to bearish · back on the 30-day average
bias.zh: 中性偏空 · 回到 30 日均线

read.en: Broadcom rose 0.7% on Oct 13 to $357.31 after a low of $348.11. It sits on its 30-day average ($357.5), just under the 5 and 10-day ($362.1 and $359.9), and below the 200-day ($368.4) and falling 100-day ($382.6). MACD has been above its signal since Sep 21 but below zero, with the histogram fading toward a cross; Parabolic SAR flipped bearish on Oct 13 ($380.8), and RSI is 48.
read.zh: 博通 10月13日上涨 0.7%，收于 $357.31，盘中低点 $348.11。股价位于 30 日均线（$357.5）附近，略低于 5 日和 10 日均线（$362.1 和 $359.9），并位于 200 日（$368.4）及下行的 100 日均线（$382.6）下方。MACD 自 9月21日起位于信号线上方但在零轴之下，柱状图收窄、趋近交叉；抛物线 SAR 于 10月13日转为看空（$380.8），RSI 为 48。

read.en: The intraday dip held above $347 support, and the close was back on the $356 shelf. Resistance is $360–362 (5 and 10-day averages), then $368–371 (200-day, tested five times) and $381–383 (Oct 6 high and 100-day). Support is $348 (Oct 13 low), then $336 (Sep 16 low). A close above $371 would target $383.
read.zh: 盘中回落守在 $347 支撑上方，收盘回到 $356 平台。阻力为 $360–362（5 日和 10 日均线），其次 $368–371（200 日均线，五次测试）及 $381–383（10月6日高点及 100 日均线）。支撑为 $348（10月13日低点），其次 $336（9月16日低点）。若收盘站上 $371，目标看 $383。
